## Stage A — architecture review by ChatGPT (2026-10-20)

**Disposition: CONDITIONAL ARCHITECTURE GO for Variant A, not authorization to implement Stage B.** The owner provided `SOURCE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT_REPORT.md` for review. I independently checked current `main` production code: `source_creator.gd::_save_source()` executes `ResourceSaver.save(source, path)` and emits the original draft via `source_saved.emit(source)`; `plugin.gd::_add_created_source()` appends that draft. The report supplies Godot 4.7.2 evidence that external `.tres` + inlined `.tscn` copies can diverge in reviewed-scene approval with same logical `source_id`, and demonstrates ordinary ExtResource behavior in the tested fixture graph.

**Accept the minimal external-source persistence model for NEW Creator saves only:** exclusively unused project-local path, successful write, typed/schema/serialized-content validation after fresh `ResourceLoader.load(..., CACHE_MODE_REUSE)`, then emit the persisted `GFVegetationSource` and bind the palette/Inspector to that object. Old embedded Sources remain valid and independent. No schema bump, relink by source_id/display_name, approval migration, local_to_scene change, renderer/resolver fixup, or destructive archive cleanup.

**Mandatory Stage B gates to include in the implementation specification:**
1. Enforce **no overwrite** of occupied disk paths and previously registered cached paths before writing; explicit user message if rejected. Save Dialog confirmation alone is insufficient. Verify existing file SHA remains unchanged and existing palette/records retain IDs and revisions, including same-name and normalized-path attempts. Do not assume this guards atomically against competing external writers; concurrency/crash recovery remain explicit limitations.
2. On success validate loaded resource is `GFVegetationSource` schema 1 with the same source_id, kind, persisted asset/card/material and Scene Fallback review fields, a usable external resource path, and default non-local Source lifetime. Do not require Godot instance_id equality across processes.
3. On save cancel/error or failed reload/validation, **do not emit success or append**. A post-save failed validation may leave a partial file: report path and failure, do not silently delete/overwrite it. If active editor set/scene changes after a valid save, don't add to the wrong set; report successfully saved but not appended.
4. Native Creator end-to-end, scenes contain `ExtResource` not a duplicate editable Source `SubResource`; save/reopen, shared two Sets, legacy embedded, approval/revision mismatch, PNG/WebP AlphaCard, GLB/Static Scene, Undo/Redo/render_only, real reimport, same-scene Windows GUI and three CI workflows. Before approving merge check GUI thumbnail/save separately because Stage A reported `HEADLESS_SCENE_THUMBNAIL: FAIL`.
5. Use disposable Codex fixtures for automation; owner interactive testing ONLY in existing `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA\go_flora_stage01_demo\demo.tscn`. Do not modify TEST_FLORA automatically or create another permanent owner test project. Do not alter current local working branch/untracked files without specific permission.

**Evidence boundary:** Report says 7/7 command probes, 121/121 data/behavior assertions, with thumbnail headless errors and physical GUI NOT_RUN. Underlying .scratch evidence was not attached to this particular review; these counts are author-reported, not independently rerun here. Only the main source code lines were independently inspected.

**Current stage remains:** STAGE_A_REVIEWED; OWNER_STAGE_B_APPROVAL_PENDING. No code implementation, new branch, PR, merge, release, or Stage 03 authorized by this comment.

## Owner authorization — Stage B Source Identity Fix (20 October 2026)

**Explicit owner decision:** «Да, давай» in response to the question whether to proceed with implementing Stage B after reviewing Stage A architecture. **Implementation of the minimal Variant A contract is AUTHORIZED.** This supersedes the previous Stage A research-only/NO-GO for code, **but does not authorize automatic merge, release, Stage 03, or migration of existing user resources**.

### Scope authorized
- Fix creation of **new** `GFVegetationSource` via `addons/go_flora/editor/source_creator.gd`: preflight unused `res://... .tres` destination and cache occupancy, save, reload with a verified safe cache policy, validate complete persisted Source identity/content/schema, emit the **reloaded canonical external Resource** to existing palette flow. The result must remain an `ExtResource` after save/reopen, not an independent editable `SubResource`.
- Strict **new-path only / NO OVERWRITE**. Reject any existing on-disk or cache-occupied destination before write, including a path containing a different valid Source, wrong resource type, colliding name or UID. Don't assume OS race-free atomicity; report edge cases. Creation is not the same as editing an existing external Source.
- Preserve `source_id`, `GFInstanceRecord`, placement IDs and transforms, schema 1, Source Kind values, Scene Fallback permission/revision/fingerprint/allowlist, render eligibility, append/Undo/Redo, archive references and legacy embedded Source behavior. Never relink old Source copies by ID/name or transfer approval fields between them.
- Save Cancel/Save Error and post-save reload/validation failure must never signal success or append to palette. On partial written file, surface exact path, do not auto-delete. Handle active scene/set changed after successful write without adding to wrong Set. Godot 4.7.2 native GUI and modal lifecycle; retain real GLB, static PackedScene, PNG/WebP AlphaCard and reviewed authored PackedScene.
- Implement focused tests in isolated Codex fixtures, preserve historical FAIL/evidence, native Editor API and true fresh-process serialization/reopen `ExtResource` checks, wrong-type/stale-cache/preexisting-path/overwrite SHA tests, shared Source across two sets/scenes, legacy sources, reimport, exact Inspector Source binding, Undo/Redo, missing-asset and review safety. Full Stage01/02/02.3/Issue13/16 regressions and three CI. Stage A headless thumbnail errors remain an explicit physical GUI QA item, not an automatic PASS.
- Branch from **current `main`** after checking repository status, based on last known `d911087157ecaa9e3ab2b92d95049f2999aebab1` (0.2.5-dev), proposed `codex/issue-18-source-identity`; new scoped PR into `main` and a **distinguishable dev build**, proposed 0.2.6-dev, plugin-only ZIP + SHA256/full manifest + Russian report. No forced checkout, reset, or destructive change to existing local branches/untracked files; safe non-destructive fetch/isolated worktree only after ensuring no user work is overwritten, else stop and report blocker.
- **Owner interactive QA:** only the existing `C:\Dev\TEST_FLORA` and its main `res://go_flora_stage01_demo/demo.tscn`, one project/one scene. Codex must NOT touch these directly. Actual GUI PASS is owner-only after manual installation with backup.

### Exit
Stop at `READY_FOR_MANUAL_QA`: commit/push PR and report tested HEAD and CI. Do not merge, publish release, implement Issue #15, clear archives, or start Stage03. The user will manually verify and authorize next steps.
